notes: Final-acceptance gap-closure car (H4 capability matrix + gap-list close-out). (1) Per-tool kill switch: `mycore.tools_off` — a settings list (or env MYCORE_TOOLS_OFF, which overrides settings) names up to 32 tools to unregister; the live registry, the loop, the ACP session and the console capability catalog all follow the same resolution, fail-closed validation rejects unknown/duplicate/malformed names at the settings API, and an unknown env name is ignored with one honest stderr note instead of crashing registry construction. (2) Channels 7 -> 9: WhatsApp outbound via the Meta Cloud API (Bearer slot + phone_number_id config; inbound honestly structural - it needs a public callback) and Signal via a local signal-cli REST daemon (explicit base URL, optional bearer slot, best-effort /v1/receive inbound polling with fail-soft empty batches, fail-closed sender allow-list); both routes carry readiness notes and zero credential echo, settings schema extended (whatsapp: phone_number_id; signal: url + allow), smoke asserts the 9-route catalog. (3) Project-context @references: a context file line of the form `@path` now inlines a sibling file (depth 1, <=16 references per file, traversal outside the context dir denied, missing/over-limit targets become visible inline markers), so AGENTS.md can pull in other local files; files without references stay byte-identical. (4) Research close-out for the final acceptance: the gap list in the comparison doc is rewritten where it had gone stale (client row now reflects the shipped desktop shell and voice session, install row reflects the one-command installer + setup wizard, channel row reflects 9-route framework with 0/9 external credentials), the adoption ledger's two overclaimed rows are corrected to what actually shipped (queue editing is web-console-only, forum topics are session isolation rather than transfer), and a new final H4 capability matrix section scores 17 baseline capabilities: 13 landed, 4 partial (all credential/decree-shaped subsets), 0 untouched.
